title: American Flag
body: 50 stars — one for each state. 13 stripes — one for each original colony.
prompt: How many stars are on the flag today?
context: The star count last changed in 1959 when Alaska and Hawaii joined the Union.

title: Bald Eagle
body: National bird since 1782 — symbol on the Great Seal of the United States.
prompt: What bird is on the Great Seal of the United States?
context: Ben Franklin famously preferred the turkey — the eagle won anyway.

title: Liberty Bell
body: Cast in 1752 for the Pennsylvania State House — cracked, still here.
prompt: What famous cracked bell is a symbol of American independence?
context: The bell rang for the first public reading of the Declaration in Philadelphia, July 8, 1776.

title: The Star-Spangled Banner
body: National anthem since 1931 — written by Francis Scott Key during the War of 1812.
prompt: What is the national anthem of the United States?
context: Key wrote it after seeing the flag still flying over Fort McHenry in 1814.

title: Great Seal
body: E pluribus unum — Out of many, one.
prompt: What Latin motto appears on the Great Seal?
context: The reverse of the seal (pyramid and eye) appears on the one-dollar bill.
